title: Illegal Functioning of Chinese Authorities

page_data.en:
COPY.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
B. REGISTER
H 543/9
18.7.33

Wayside Station.
July 13, 1933.

Illegal functioning of Chinese Authorities.

Sir,

I beg to report at 10.50 a.m. 13.7.33 Mr. Tsu Hung-hsun,
No.71, Lane 171, Yochow Road, came to the Station and produced
a letter from the Secretary-General in reply to his letter of
July 4, 1933, re surveying land by the Land Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

It appears that at 10.30 a.m. 13/7/33 four Chinese
from the Land Bureau came to his residence and began measuring
up the land. As this property is within the Settlement limits,
he objected to the procedure. Inspector West and S.I. Ling
accompanied the complainant to Yochow Road and brought to the
Station two Chinese named Yao Fu Pong and Sung Ming with their
instruments. The first named produced a card establishing
his identity and a letter in Chinese from the Land Bureau of
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai authorising them to function
on the said property.

On the instructions of D.O. "C" Division, both men were
warned to discontinue their activities in the Settlement and
released.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

(Sgd.) B.T. Walker.
Officer in charge.

（左侧边注：See also O 944）

上海公共租界
B. 登记簿
H 543/9
1933年7月18日

路边警亭。
1933年7月13日。

中国当局的非法活动。

先生：

谨此报告，1933年7月13日上午10时50分，住约克路（Yochow Road）171弄71号的朱鸿勋（Tsu Hung-hsun）先生来到警亭，出示了秘书长回复其1933年7月4日来信的函件，该信涉及大上海市政府地政局对其土地进行测量一事。

据悉，1933年7月13日上午10时30分，四名来自地政局的中国人来到其住所，开始测量土地。由于该房产位于租界范围内，他对该行为表示反对。韦斯特（West）巡官和凌（Ling）高级巡佐陪同投诉人前往约克路，并将两名携带仪器的中国人姚福鹏（Yao Fu Pong，音译）和宋明（Sung Ming，音译）带至警亭。前者出示了一张证明其身份的卡片，以及一封由大上海市政府地政局出具的中文信函，授权他们在上述房产执行公务。

根据“C”分区值班警官的指示，对两人均予以警告，要求停止在租界内的活动，随后将其释放。

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）B.T. 沃克（B.T. Walker）。
主管警官。

（左侧边注：另见 O 944）

July 6, 1933.

Mr. Tsu Hung-hsun,
House 71, Lane NO.171,
Yochow Road.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter of
July 4, 1933, stating that the Land Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai has notified its
intention of making a survey of your land in Yochow Road
for the purpose of assessment for land tax, and asking
whether or not the Council has approved the proposed
action.

In reply, I have to state that the Land Bureau
is not permitted to operate in the Settlement and that
its proposed action has not therefore received the approval
of the Council.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

(Sgd.) S. Fessenden.
Secretary General.
page_data.zh:
副本

1933年7月6日。

朱鸿勋（Tsu Hung-hsun）先生，
约克路（Yochow Road）171弄71号。

先生：

兹确认收到您1933年7月4日的来信，信中称大上海市政府地政局已通知拟对您位于约克路的土地进行测量，以便评估地税，并询问工部局是否已批准该拟议行动。

现答复如下：地政局不被允许在租界内运作，因此其拟议行动未获工部局批准。

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）S. 费森登（S. Fessenden）。
秘书长。

Translation of letter to Secretary
General from Tsu Hung-hsun dated
4th July, 1933.

Land Tax: Chinese proposal to collect

My residence is situated at Nos.61 and 71, Lane No.171,
Yochow Road. As this place is within Settlement limits, all
matters concerning public safety and construction work are
in the hands of the Council and residents are duly protected.
Recently the Land Bureau of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai sent the tipao of the 2nd Tu to notify us that within
a few days a survey will be made of the land of different
owners in this locality and that a land tax will be collected
from the owners this year. I am very anxious to be informed
whether or not the Council has approved the proposed action of
the said Bureau. Please give a definite reply so that I may
know how to deal with the matter.

(Signed & Chopped) Tsu Hung-hsun (朱鴻勳).

朱鸿勋于1933年7月4日致秘书长的信件译文。

地税：中方征收提议

本人寓所位于约克路（Yochow Road）171弄61号和71号。因该处位于租界范围内，所有有关公共安全及建筑工程事宜均由工部局掌管，居民亦得到妥善保护。近日，大上海市政府地政局派遣第二图（2nd Tu）的地保通知我们，将在数日内对该地区不同业主的土地进行测量，并于今年向业主征收地税。本人亟欲知悉工部局是否已批准该局的上述拟议行动。请给予明确答复，以便本人知晓如何处理此事。

（签名并盖章）朱鸿勋（Tsu Hung-hsun）。
